sources.snippet: Color: 60:30:10, dominant gunmetal blue and wet slate (the tideflats and sky) / secondary sodium amber and rust-red (burning floodlights, corroded steel) / accent magnesium white and cobalt blue (the failing reactor core and its arc-flashes). Camera: physical cine lens. 180 degree shutter motion blur. Continuous handheld operator shake, motivated by the ground concussions rolling through the shallow water.
